For iversion routes, all those on Production seem to follow the street centre lines. The user guide refers to providing sufficient intermediate points so the diversion path can be plotted. There could be too much ambiguity with this, so given all Diversions are plotted already following centre lines, shouldn't this be the guidance (and the intermediate points idea dropped)?


The way to define diversion routes is permissive. In the example that DfT has provided we showed the use of intermediate points (using the directedLinear geometry type). An alternative would be to use a linearGeometry geometry type (which defines a linestring which can have directionality).

DfT is open to stakeholder inputs on alternative approaches, that could be considered in the future.
